intent: Publish every distinct icon glyph from the authoritative Icons.svg alongside the existing Basic Elements corpus, preserve compatibility, and make the complete icon catalog directly discoverable in Showcase.

provenance.ref: AGENTS.md and shlz-design-source/raw/svg/Icons.svg establish the raw SVG as authoritative; the extraction report records 104 core candidates and a two-calendar collision.
openspec/config.yaml requires backward compatibility; docs/icon-methodology.md forbids unconfirmed silent substitution, so existing names remain stable and distinct collisions receive explicit names.

apps/showcase/src/showcase-navigation.json omits Icons while apps/showcase/src/main.js nests the catalog in an unlinked details element; the existing navigation contract supplies the discoverable integration seam.
User explicitly requested that all icons including calendar be added to the library and that Showcase be fixed.
The user explicitly requested implementation, not planning only.
